rules: 1. hasDepartment(X, Y) :- collaboratesWith(X, Z), hasDepartment(Z, Y)
2. hasDepartment(X, Y) :- locatedIn(X, Z), hasDepartment(Z, Y)
3. hasDepartment(X, Y) :- hasFaculty(X, Z), departmentWithin(Z, Y)
4. hasDepartment(X, Y) :- partOfOrganization(X, Z), hasDepartment(Z, Y)
5. hasDepartment(X, Y) :- managesCampus(X, Z), hasDepartment(Z, Y)
